<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, I'm back for my second session. Alison has confirmed a time and booked the meeting.

My task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The confirmed time is Thursday at 10:00 AM. I have the `send_confirmation_email` tool for this. I'll need to provide the day, start time, and body of the email.

*   Day: Thursday
*   Start: 10:00
*   Body: I'll write a professional confirmation email. Something like: "This email confirms the partners' meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Time. This will be a 30-minute meeting."

This is a straightforward action. I'll send the email and then end my session. The task will then be complete.This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled as follows:

Date: Thursday, November 19, 2026
Time: 10:00 AM - 10:30 AM Eastern Time

Please let us know if you have any questions.
